$comment: Members of games/gen{2,3,4,5}/Overlay.vue that share a name but not a body, each with the reason the difference is intended, and a fingerprint of every generation's body at review time. tools/parity/drift-check.ts fails on any difference not listed here, on a listed member whose bodies have changed since review, and on a listed member whose bodies now agree. A reason that starts with UNREVIEWED was written by --update and is still to be adjudicated: quirk (keep, say why) or omission (port the change to the other generations, then --update drops the entry).
